messages:
Lina Hart: hi all! i'm Lina, just started today — joining product analytics from Lisbon 🇵🇹. love ceramics, surfing, and terrible ukulele covers. excited to be here!
Devon (People Ops): welcome @Lina!! :tada: we'll send a welcome kit and a desk plant if you're office-based. dm me your tee size and address.
Lina Hart: thanks @Devon! i'm remote for now but might come to SF later this year. curious — are standing desks available at the office?
Noel: welcome Lina :) standing desks are available on request, file a ticket with eng-ops and they'll sort it within a week.
Cassidy Rambo: hi Lina! ping me when you're up for a virtual coffee — i'm on east coast evenings and can trade ukulele tips for surf stories. :coffee: :surfing_man:
Mira Patel: also FYI, we have a monthly craft swap in #random — ceramics would be a hit. and we do a welcome zoom on Thursday at 10am PT.
Lina Hart: craft swap?? count me in. what do people usually bring? tiny vases? mugs?
Cassidy Rambo: mostly small things, + stickers and weird snacks. last month someone mailed mini jam from their hometown.
Lina Hart: wow mini jam sounds delightful. :) also, how do I get access to the build VPN for private docs? i filled out the form but not sure of next steps.
Devon (People Ops): People Ops Bot will nudge infra. make sure you completed the IT form: https://intranet.redwood/it/onboarding
People Ops Bot: New hire checklist: IT access pending. Infra team: please provision VPN for lina.hart by Day 3. https://infra-tickets.redwood/t/12345
Lina Hart: got it — thanks! thrilled to meet everyone, i'll bring a tiny glazed vase to the craft swap (and maybe a ukulele cover if brave). :smile:
thread_summary: Lina Hart joins from Lisbon; team welcomes her, discusses standing desk requests, craft swap and welcome Zoom, VPN/IT onboarding steps and People Ops actions.
